subject: Aperture Systems: marketplace listing - support hours & branding claims clarification
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@aperturesys.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 1 Dec 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace listing - support hours and trademark usage

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking a look earlier this week. We're preparing our AWS and GCP marketplace listings for Aperture Systems and have a couple of policy items we need cleared before publishing: 

- Support SLA language: We currently offer 9x5 with 24x7 optional escalation. Marketplace copy guidance asks for a single support window. Can we list "24x7 incident escalation" while keeping day-to-day support as 9x5?
- Trademark usage: We want to use the Redwood "Powered by" badge alongside our logo. Are there any size/placement restrictions for co-branded listings?

Attaching our draft listing copy and the requested asset bundle. If you can confirm what will pass AWS/GCP validation and Co-Sell policies, that would be great — also loop in anyone on your team who owns the co-sell enablement checklist.

Appreciate it,
Maria Lopez
Head of Marketplace Ops
Aperture Systems
attachments: Marketplace_Guidelines_v2.pdf; Branding_Assets_2028.zip; Aperture_Support_Window_Request.xlsx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@aperturesys.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 1 Dec 2028 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing - support hours and trademark usage

Hi Maria — thanks, attached files received. Quick answers upfront, then next steps: 

- Support language: You can state "24x7 incident escalation" for marketplace copy as long as the listing (1) documents the primary support hours (9x5) and (2) includes an SLA or routing note for how 24x7 incidents are handled (pager or on-call). AWS/GCP validation teams look for no ambiguous claims that imply full operational support 24/7 unless you have that commitment.

- Badge placement: Co-branding is fine; Redwood requires the "Powered by Redwood" badge to be visually secondary to your company mark and not used in customer-facing marketing outside the listing without separate permission. Size should be no larger than 20% of the primary logo width on the listing hero.

Next steps I recommend: 
1) Kimberly, can you confirm the legal-safe phrasing for the support line and produce the exact copy we should use on AWS/Azure/GCP (one-liner + footnote)?
2) Ben, can you run a quick verification against the Marketplace Guidelines v2 and flag any claims that need to be toned down (SLAs, uptime %, regional support availability)?
3) Maria, if you can provide the final one-liner + a link to your on-call escalation doc, we'll prep the packaging for submission.

I'll also copy Laura for co-sell enablement once we have the compliant listing language.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: Marketplace listing - support hours and trademark usage

Jordan / Kim — I reviewed their draft against the Marketplace_Guidelines_v2.pdf. Summary of actionable items: 

- Remove the phrase "24/7 production support". Replace with: "Primary support hours: Mon–Fri 9am–5pm PT. 24x7 incident escalation via on-call rota."
- For uptime claims: they currently say "99.99% availability across regions" — we need substantiation. Suggest changing to "Designed for multi-region resiliency; availability claims subject to published SLA."
- Data residency: Their copy lists EU data residency for customers in EMEA. Need evidence or remove until they provide a data processing addendum.

I redlined examples in the Drive doc (link below). Also adding a small legal-friendly footnote for badge usage and a required asset checklist for AWS/GCP layout.

Doc links: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/marketplace-guidelines-v2#redlines

If these changes are acceptable, we should: 
- Ask Aperture to accept the redlines and upload a signed copy of the asset checklist.
- Laura, please queue co-sell enablement once redlines are accepted — we may need a short enablement slide deck and a partner profile published.

Ben Carter
Marketplace Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
attachments: none

- Removed the 99.99% uptime callout and replaced with: "Designed for multi-region resiliency; availability claims subject to published SLA."
- We'll attach a signed asset checklist and provide the on-call escalation doc by EOD Thursday.

Once we upload the revised assets, please confirm if any additional documentation is required for AWS co-sell enablement (we are on an upcoming AWS co-sell cohort). Also looping in aws-partnerships@amazon.com per Jordan's earlier note on co-sell steps.

Best,
